reviews.text: There are twelve crop types. The short day makes every choice pleasantly meaningful.
Days end before I can relax, so the clock turns farming into a rush.
I enjoy planning around the compact day, yet I sometimes resent being hurried home.
The limited daylight gives each trip a satisfying purpose.
